column1: Ichimoku Kinkō Hyō / 一目均衡表|Japanese chart systems|OHLC|Tenkan and Kijun are midpoints of rolling high/low ranges; Senkou A averages those lines, Senkou B uses a longer range; the cloud is drawn forward and Chikou backward.|ichimoku,IchimokuKinkoHyo,IchimokuIndicator|Separate calculation time from display offset. A historical Chikou plot is not information available at that plotted date.

Heikin Ashi / 平均足|Japanese chart systems|OHLC|Synthetic close averages OHLC; synthetic open averages the previous synthetic open and close. This smooths candle appearance.|heikinashi|Synthetic candle prices are not executable broker quotes.

Renko / 練行足|Alternative chart systems|Ticks or ordered lower-timeframe prices|Adds bricks when price traverses a selected box size; time between bricks is irregular.|renko|OHLC reconstruction can conceal path ambiguity; ATR-sized historical bricks may change with settings.

Kagi / 鉤足|Alternative chart systems|Ordered prices|Alternates vertical legs after a reversal threshold; prior swing breaks change line state.|kagi|Requires ordered price paths; chart-derived fills must use actual prices.

Point & Figure|Alternative chart systems|Ordered prices|Uses X/O columns for box-sized advances and declines, reversing after a configured box count.|pointandfigure|Intrabar high/low ordering affects columns.

Line Break|Alternative chart systems|Prices|Prints a new line when price exceeds thresholds from the preceding lines; reversals use a configurable line count.|linebreak|Irregular chart events are not fixed-time candles.

KDJ / 随机指标|Chinese formula systems|HLC|Normalizes close within a recent high/low range to RSV, smooths into K and D, then forms J = 3K − 2D.|KDJ,kdj|TongDaXin SMA is recursive smoothing, not an ordinary simple moving average; J can exceed 0–100.

BBI / 多空指标|Chinese formula systems|Close|Averages four simple moving averages to form a combined bull/bear baseline; periods differ across implementations.|BBI|MyTT defaults use 3/6/12/20; a different script may use 24 for the last period.

BIAS / 乖离率 / Kairi|Chinese/Japanese formulas|Close|Measures percentage displacement from a moving average: 100 × (price − MA)/MA.|BIAS,bias,kairi_relative_index,disparity_index|Same concept appears under several names; it is not several independent signals.

PSY / 心理线|Chinese formula systems|Close|Reports the percentage of up-closing bars in a rolling period; often accompanied by a smoothed signal.|PSY,psl|Counts bar direction, not investor survey sentiment.

BRAR / 人气意愿指标|Chinese formula systems|OHLC|AR compares high−open to open−low; BR compares movement relative to the previous close, aggregated over a window.|BRAR,brar|Exact clipping and zero-denominator conventions vary.

CR / 能量指标|Chinese formula systems|HLC|Compares upward and downward movement around the previous bar midpoint; aggregates into a relative strength ratio.|CR|Different platforms may use different reference prices.

VR / 成交量比率|Chinese formula systems|Close + volume|Compares volume accumulated on up bars with down-bar volume, allocating unchanged bars according to its formula.|VR|Needs meaningful volume. CFD tick-volume VR has different economic meaning from exchange-volume VR.

DFMA / DMA indicator|Chinese formula systems|Close|Subtracts a long moving average from a short one and smooths the difference.|DFMA|The name DMA also means dynamic moving average elsewhere; resolve the formula before porting.

EXPMA|Chinese formula systems|Close|Plots exponential moving averages at multiple lengths to compare trend direction and crossings.|EXPMA,ema|Usually an EMA presentation variant rather than a new mathematical family.

TAQ|Chinese formula systems|HLC|Builds a highest-high/lowest-low channel and its midpoint over a chosen window.|TAQ|Close relative to a current-bar channel is not the same as breakout above the previous channel.

KTN|Chinese formula systems|OHLC|MyTT combines an EMA of typical price with ATR-based envelopes; belongs to the Keltner family.|KTN,kc|Match typical-price source and ATR smoothing when comparing outputs.

XSII / 薛斯通道 II|Chinese formula systems|Close|Combines a smoothed price centre with percentage envelopes and a dynamic channel construction.|XSII|Treat this implementation as a defined variant; the name alone does not uniquely specify every platform version.

Chanlun / 缠论 / CZSC|Chinese structural systems|OHLC|Builds inclusion-adjusted bars, fractals, strokes, segments and central zones; signal modules describe structural relationships.|czsc|A central zone or stroke can change while forming. Modules are not independent profitable indicators.
SMA|Moving averages|Price|Arithmetic mean of the last N observations, with equal weights.|sma,SimpleMovingAverage|Lookback units are bars, not automatically days.
EMA|Moving averages|Price|Recursively updates the average using α = 2/(N+1); recent observations receive more weight.|ema,ExponentialMovingAverage|Seed choice and warm-up affect cross-library parity.

Wilder RMA / SMMA|Moving averages|Price|Recursive smoothing with α approximately 1/N after an initial seed.|rma,smma,smoothed_moving_average,WildersMovingAverage|Chinese SMA(X,N,M) uses α=M/N and is not identical to SMA arithmetic averaging.
WMA / LWMA|Moving averages|Price|Weights recent samples linearly more heavily than older samples.|wma,WeightedMovingAverage|Check weight orientation and initial valid index.

DEMA / TEMA|Moving averages|Price|DEMA = 2E1 − E2; TEMA = 3E1 − 3E2 + E3, using successive EMAs.|dema,tema,DoubleExponentialMovingAverage,TripleExponentialMovingAverage|Lag compensation can overshoot and react more strongly to noise.

Tillson T3|Moving averages|Price|Combines successive EMA filters with coefficients controlled by a volume-factor parameter.|t3,T3MovingAverage,t3_moving_average|The volume-factor parameter is a smoothing coefficient, not an observed volume series.

Hull Moving Average|Moving averages|Price|Combines WMA at full and half length, then smooths the compensated result over approximately √N.|hma,HullMovingAverage|Integer rounding rules can produce platform differences.

ALMA|Moving averages|Price|Applies Gaussian weights with configurable offset and spread across the rolling price window.|alma,ArnaudLegouxMovingAverage|Finta's ALMA entry is a placeholder; use an actual implementation from another source.

KAMA|Adaptive filters|Price|Uses an efficiency ratio to adjust smoothing between fast and slow limits.|kama,KaufmanAdaptiveMovingAverage|A trend-adaptive line still requires warm-up and a precisely defined seed.

VIDYA|Adaptive filters|Price|Changes EMA weight using a momentum/variability measure such as absolute CMO.|vidya,vidya_variable_index_dynamic_average|Variants differ. Finta's named VIDYA method raises NotImplementedError.

FRAMA|Adaptive filters|HLC or selected price|Estimates fractal dimension from subwindow ranges and maps it into an adaptive smoothing coefficient.|frama,fractal_adaptive_moving_average|Window parity and coefficient bounds matter.

MAMA / FAMA|Adaptive filters|Price|Uses Hilbert-transform phase behaviour to adapt moving-average speed; FAMA follows MAMA more slowly.|mama,ehlers_mesa_adaptive_moving_averages,MesaAdaptiveMovingAverage|Finta's MAMA is a placeholder; other implementations are present.

McGinley Dynamic|Adaptive filters|Price|Updates a moving baseline with a denominator dependent on the price-to-baseline ratio.|mcgd,McGinleyDynamic,mcginley_dynamic|Numerical handling near zero needs review.
ZLEMA|Adaptive filters|Price|Adds a lag compensation term to price before exponential smoothing.|zlma,zlema,ZeroLagExponentialMovingAverage|Zero lag in a name does not mean future price is known.

Jurik Moving Average / RSX variants|Adaptive filters|Price|Public scripts implement smooth adaptive lines or RSI-like oscillators carrying Jurik-related names.|jurik_moving_average,jurik_rsx,rsx|A public approximation is not proof of identity with proprietary Jurik software.

Ehlers Super Smoother|Digital signal processing|Price|A recursive low-pass filter uses period-derived coefficients and previous filter states to attenuate high-frequency variation.|ssf,ehlers_super_smoother_filter,SuperSmoother|Initialization and coefficient conventions affect outputs.

Ehlers Ultimate Smoother|Digital signal processing|Price|A low-lag smoothing construction combines high-pass/all-pass relationships to preserve lower-frequency components.|ultimate_smoother|Primary publication and official PineCodersTASC page are linked; no independently audited local implementation claimed.

Ehlers Roofing Filter|Digital signal processing|Price|Combines high-pass detrending with low-pass smoothing to retain a selected cycle band.|ehlers_roofing_filter|Filter period is not a forecast horizon.

Ehlers Cyber Cycle|Digital signal processing|Price|Smooths and detrends price with recursive terms to isolate oscillatory components.|ehlers_cyber_cycle|Turning points can change on the current open bar.

Laguerre Filter / Laguerre RSI|Digital signal processing|Price|Uses a sequence of Laguerre states; directional state changes can be normalized into an RSI-like output.|laguerre_filter,laguerre_rsi|Gamma governs the responsiveness and smoothness trade-off.

Fisher / Inverse Fisher|Digital signal processing|Normalized series|Transforms a bounded input to emphasize extremes; inverse Fisher compresses an oscillator into bounded outputs.|fisher,FisherTransform,ift_rsi|Clipping near ±1 is essential for finite Fisher values.

Hilbert dominant cycle / sine / phasor|Digital signal processing|Price|Estimates phase and cycle properties using Hilbert-transform approximations.|HT_DCPERIOD,HT_DCPHASE,HT_SINE,HT_PHASOR,HT_TRENDMODE|Unstable initial periods and phase wrap require explicit handling.

Kalman Filter|Statistical filters|Price + model variances|Predicts a latent price state and uncertainty, then updates using an uncertainty-dependent gain when a new price arrives.|kalman|Q/R assumptions specify the model; a filter is causal, a backward smoother uses future observations.

Moving Median / Hampel Filter|Robust filters|Price|Median filtering reduces sensitivity to isolated outliers; Hampel logic identifies extreme deviations around a local median.|moving_median,hampel_filter|A centred window is noncausal unless results are delayed.

Gaussian / Butterworth filters|Digital signal processing|Price|Low-pass filtering suppresses rapid fluctuations using Gaussian weights or recursive Butterworth coefficients.|gaussian_filter,butterworth_filter|Different implementations can be trailing or centred.
RSI|Momentum|Close|Normalizes smoothed average gains versus losses into a 0–100 oscillator.|rsi,RelativeStrengthIndex|Overbought can persist in a trend; default seed conventions differ.
Stochastic|Momentum|HLC|Locates close within the rolling high-low range; smooths %K into %D.|stoch,stochastic,Stochastic|Specify fast/slow smoothing and zero-range handling.

Stochastic RSI|Momentum|Close|Applies the stochastic range normalization to RSI values rather than raw prices.|stochrsi,StochasticRsi|Two indicator layers increase sensitivity and warm-up requirements.

Stochastic Momentum Index|Momentum|HLC|Double-smooths close displacement from the range midpoint and normalizes by a smoothed half-range.|smi,StochasticMomentumIndex,stochastic_momentum_index|Distinct from SMI Ergodic and ordinary stochastic.
Connors RSI|Momentum|Close|Averages price RSI, RSI of the signed streak length, and the percentile rank of a one-bar return.|crsi,ConnorsRsi|Percent-rank conventions and tie handling vary.

QQE / QQE MOD|Momentum|Close|Smooths RSI and builds adaptive trailing bands from RSI changes; QQE MOD combines two QQE states.|qqe|ATR-like smoothing operates on RSI changes, not automatically on price ranges.

WaveTrend|Momentum|HLC or typical price|EMA-centres price, normalizes displacement by smoothed absolute deviation, then smooths the normalized series and a signal line.|WTO|Multiple scripts use different smoothing and threshold settings.

MACD / PPO / APO|Momentum|Price|Compares fast and slow averages; MACD/APO show absolute differences, PPO divides by the slow average.|macd,ppo,apo|These are related transformations, not independent evidence votes.

ROC / Momentum|Momentum|Price|ROC reports percentage change from N bars ago; momentum usually reports the absolute difference.|roc,mom,Momentum,MomentumPercent|Compare normalized rather than raw point thresholds across the four markets.
CCI|Momentum|HLC|Divides typical-price displacement from its mean by a scaled mean absolute deviation.|cci,CommodityChannelIndex|The standard deviation is not the denominator of classical CCI.
CMO|Momentum|Close|Normalizes the difference between summed gains and losses by their total.|cmo,ChandeMomentumOscillator|Smoothing differs from RSI despite shared input changes.

TSI / SMI Ergodic|Momentum|Close|Normalizes double-smoothed price changes by double-smoothed absolute changes; a signal EMA can be added.|tsi,TrueStrengthIndex|Do not confuse True Strength Index with Trend Strength Index.
Schaff Trend Cycle|Momentum|Close|Combines MACD with stochastic-style cycle normalization and smoothing.|stc,stc_schaff_trend_cycle|Variants differ in recursive smoothing and lookbacks.

Coppock / KST / Special K|Momentum|Close|Combines and smooths rates of change over several horizons to represent longer and shorter momentum cycles.|coppock_curve,kst,pring_special_k|Closely related families should not be counted as independent confirmations.

Ultimate Oscillator|Momentum|HLC|Aggregates buying pressure relative to true range over three windows with fixed relative weights.|uo,UltimateOscillator|Check preceding-close definition and zero denominators.

DeMarker|Momentum|HL|Compares positive high changes with positive low decreases and normalizes their moving totals.|demarker,DeMarkerIndicator|A bounded oscillator still does not by itself define an executable strategy.

ADX / DMI|Trend strength|HLC|Derives +DI and −DI from directional movement relative to true range, then smooths their normalized difference into ADX.|adx,dmi,AverageDirectionalIndex|ADX strength is separate from +DI/−DI direction.
Aroon|Trend strength|HL|Scales bars-since-high and bars-since-low into Up/Down lines; their difference forms an oscillator.|aroon,AroonOscillator|Tie handling for repeated extremes affects values.
Vortex|Trend direction|HLC|Normalizes cross-bar high/low movement sums by total true range to produce VI+ and VI−.|vortex,Vortex|Confirm rolling window and first-bar conventions.

Choppiness / VHF|Regime measures|HLC|CHOP compares accumulated range to total window excursion; VHF compares directional excursion to total price movement.|chop,vhf,ChoppinessIndex|These measure path efficiency or consolidation, not a guaranteed future breakout.

Efficiency Ratio|Regime measures|Price|Absolute net change divided by the sum of absolute step changes measures directional path efficiency.|er,ER,EfficiencyRatio|A high value describes a past path; it does not prove continuation.

Trend Strength / CTI / RCI|Regime measures|Price|Correlation-based measures compare prices or their ranks with time to quantify directional consistency.|cti,rci,TrendStrengthIndex|Pearson price correlation and rank correlation are distinct definitions.

Hurst Exponent|Regime measures|Price or returns|Estimates scaling/persistence using a particular statistical procedure and lookback.|Hurst,HurstExponent|Short-sample estimates are noisy; estimator choice matters.

Entropy|Regime measures|Price-derived distribution|Summarizes dispersion or uncertainty of a chosen probability representation of the series.|entropy|Results depend on how probabilities or bins are constructed; not all entropy indicators measure the same object.

Bollinger Bands / %B / Width|Volatility bands|Price|Plots a moving centre with standard-deviation envelopes; %B locates price and bandwidth measures spread of the bands.|bbands,BollingerBands|Touching a band is a description, not automatic mean reversion.

Keltner / STARC|Volatility bands|HLC|Uses ATR/range-based envelopes around a moving-average centre.|kc,KeltnerChannels,stoller_average_range_channels|ATR and standard deviation bands respond differently to gaps.

Donchian / Price Channel|Breakout structure|HL|Upper/lower lines are rolling extremes with a midpoint centre.|donchian,DonchianChannel|A breakout rule normally compares against an already known previous channel.

Squeeze / TTM-style squeeze|Volatility compression|OHLC|Detects Bollinger bands inside Keltner channels; momentum is displayed separately, often with a regression histogram.|squeeze,SqueezeMomentum|Squeeze does not specify the eventual direction; branded versions need not share identical code.

ATR / NATR / ADR|Volatility|OHLC|ATR smooths gap-aware true range; NATR normalizes by price; ADR averages daily high-low spans.|atr,natr,AverageTrueRange|Range units must match each instrument; ATR and ADR are not interchangeable.

Historical / Realized Volatility|Volatility|Returns|Aggregates squared returns or their standard deviation, with an explicit sampling interval and annualization factor.|stdev,StandardDeviation,HistoricalVolatility|Trading sessions and annualization conventions change comparisons.

Rogers-Satchell range volatility|Volatility|OHLC|Combines log high/open, high/close, low/open and low/close products into a range-based variance estimate.|ROGERSSATCHELL,RogersSatchellVolatility|Requires strictly positive prices; an issue for unadjusted historical oil series containing nonpositive quotes.
Ulcer Index / drawdown|Downside risk|Price|Measures depth and persistence of percentage drawdowns from recent highs.|ui,UlcerIndex|Measures downside path risk rather than symmetric return volatility.

Supertrend|Trailing trend/stop|HLC|Creates ATR-multiple bands and carries a selected band forward according to price breaks and previous state.|supertrend|Open-bar flips can disappear before the bar closes.

Chandelier Exit|Trailing stop|HLC|Places stops an ATR multiple away from rolling highs/lows, with stateful tightening rules.|chandelier_exit,chandelier,Chandelier|Exact prior-stop crossing logic matters for porting.

Parabolic SAR|Trailing stop|HL|Updates stop-and-reverse points using an acceleration factor and trend extremes.|psar,sar,ParabolicStopAndReverse|Initial trend seed and acceleration caps affect switches.

HalfTrend|Trailing trend|OHLC|Uses rolling extremes, smoothed prices and persistent trend state to build a stepped trend line and ATR channel.|halftrend|A named port must be checked against the actual author implementation.

UT Bot|Trailing trend|Price + ATR|Uses an ATR-distance trailing stop and price/short-average crossings to generate alerts.|utbot|The original publication is linked; a chart alert does not define position sizing or fill rules.

Chande Kroll / NRTR|Trailing stop|OHLC|Combines directional extremes or trailing reversals with volatility/percentage distances.|cksp,nrtr_nick_rypock_trailing_reverse|Different trailing stop families can produce strongly correlated signals.

OBV / PVT / ADL|Volume accumulation|OHLCV|OBV signs total volume by close direction; PVT weights volume by percentage return; ADL weights by close location within range.|obv,pvt,ad|These are three distinct price-volume accumulation rules.

CMF / Chaikin Oscillator|Volume flow|OHLCV|CMF normalizes accumulated money-flow volume; Chaikin Oscillator compares short and long EMA values of ADL.|cmf,adosc|Both depend on the meaning and completeness of volume.

MFI / Force / Ease of Movement|Volume flow|OHLCV|MFI normalizes signed typical-price flow; Force multiplies price change by volume; EOM relates midpoint movement to volume and range.|mfi,efi,eom|Do not treat CFD tick counts as centralized exchange turnover.

Klinger / VFI / FVE|Volume flow|OHLCV|Alternative volume-pressure calculations use price direction, range or volatility thresholds before smoothing or accumulation.|kvo,VFI,FVE|Filter thresholds and scaling vary substantially.

VWAP / Anchored VWAP|Volume benchmarks|Price + actual or proxy volume|Computes Σ(price×volume)/Σ(volume) from a session or event anchor.|vwap,Vwap|A price-only approximation cannot reproduce the same quantity; anchors must be known at decision time.
VWMA / EVWMA|Volume averages|Price + volume|VWMA uses a fixed rolling weighted window; EVWMA uses an elastic volume-sensitive update.|vwma,EVWMA|Not equivalent to session VWAP.

RVOL / Volume at Time|Volume participation|Timestamped volume|Compares current volume with historical expected volume, optionally matched by clock time.|rvol,rvol_time,RelativeDailyVolume|Match comparable sessions and daylight-saving transitions.

Volume Profile / POC / VAH / VAL|Auction tools|Price-level volume or lower-timeframe approximation|Distributes traded volume across price bins; POC is the largest bin and value area is constructed around volume concentration.|vp,VolumeProfile|OHLCV-only reconstruction is an estimate; session and binning rules affect levels.

TPO / Market Profile|Auction tools|Time-price visits|Counts price-level visits across fixed time blocks; builds a distribution of time participation rather than volume.|tpo|Time-at-price is different from actual volume-at-price.

Delta / Cumulative Delta|Order flow|Aggressor-classified trades or an explicitly stated proxy|Delta sums buyer-initiated minus seller-initiated volume; CVD accumulates it over an anchor period.|delta,cvd|TradingView intrabar direction estimates and true bid/ask aggressor data are not equivalent.

Footprint / Imbalance / Absorption|Order flow|Bid/ask trades by price + ordered events|Displays buy/sell volume by price, tests imbalance ratios and relates aggressive flow to price response.|footprint|Cannot reconstruct true absorption or bid/ask footprint from four OHLC numbers.

DOM / Order-book imbalance|Order flow|Timestamped depth/order events|Compares displayed bid and ask depth, updates, cancellations and queue behaviour.|orderbook|Displayed liquidity is not executed volume; spoofing and feed coverage affect interpretation.

Opening Range / Initial Balance|Session structure|OHLC + timezone/session|Records high/low of a predetermined opening window; monitors price relative to the completed range.|openingrange,InitialBalance|Do not use the final opening-range high before that opening window has ended.

Pivot Points / CPR / Camarilla|Session levels|Completed prior OHLC|Calculates deterministic reference levels from the preceding session, with different formula families.|pivot,PivotPointsHighLow|Session boundaries and method names must be explicit.

Fractals / Zigzag / Swing pivots|Market structure|HL|Identifies local extrema with right-side confirmation or reversal thresholds and connects significant swings.|zigzag,fractals,WILLIAMS_FRACTAL|Confirmed historical pivot location is earlier than the moment it became knowable.

BOS / CHoCH|Market structure|OHLC + a defined swing algorithm|Marks breaks of swing levels, distinguishing continuation and possible change in structural direction.|bos_choch|Definitions depend on pivot confirmation, close/wick rules and lag.

Order Blocks|Market structure|OHLCV + structural rules|Labels a preceding price area associated with a defined structural impulse and tracks mitigation.|ob|Price-bar order blocks do not directly identify institutional inventory.

FVG / Inverse FVG|Market structure|OHLC|A three-bar gap condition marks nonoverlap between the first and third bars; inverse variants track later invalidation/reuse.|fvg|Some implementations attach the result to the middle bar before the third bar actually exists.

Liquidity Sweeps / EQH / EQL|Market structure|OHLC + confirmed swings|Clusters similar highs/lows and detects excursions through a level followed by a specified rejection.|liquidity,smc_sweep|A sweep label is a rule-based price pattern, not proof of stop orders in the book.

Previous Day/Week High-Low|Market structure|Completed session OHLC|Projects already completed prior-session extremes as reference levels.|previous_high_low|Broker days, New York sessions and exchange sessions produce different boundaries.

Fibonacci / Pitchfork / Regression channels|Geometric tools|Price + selected anchors|Projects ratios, median-line parallels or statistical trend channels from selected price anchors.|LinearRegression,linreg|Automatically selected historical anchors may revise as later pivots arrive.

Harmonics: Gartley / Bat / Butterfly / Crab / Shark / Cypher|Geometric patterns|Confirmed swing points|Classifies multi-leg structures by constrained retracement and extension ratios.|harmonic|Ratio tolerances and pivot definitions are part of the method; a pattern name is not a full algorithm.

Elliott Wave|Structural theories|Price + wave-labelling rules|Labels nested impulse/correction structures subject to a chosen set of wave constraints.|elliott|Competing valid counts and relabelling make retrospective chart appearance unreliable as live evidence.

Wyckoff / VSA / Weis Wave|Structural theories|OHLCV + specified event rules|Examines price spread, volume, tests and wave accumulation to describe accumulation/distribution hypotheses.|wyckoff,weis|Narrative labels must become deterministic rules before testing; volume quality matters.

Gann / square-of-nine / time cycles|Geometric theories|Price scale + time coordinates|Constructs geometric price/time levels from explicit scaling and anchor conventions.|gann|A line angle changes with chart scaling; claims require a precise invariant definition.

Candlestick pattern families|Pattern recognition|OHLC|Algorithms compare body, wick, gap and relative-size relationships across one or more bars.|CDLDOJI,CDLENGULFING,CDLHAMMER|Pattern outputs describe candle arrangements, not calibrated win probabilities; trend context may not be checked.

Nadaraya-Watson envelope / smoother|Kernel methods|Price|Uses kernel-weighted averages to estimate a smooth curve and optional residual bands.|nadaraya|A trailing endpoint estimate can be causal; a centred/repainting display uses future observations relative to older bars.

Lorentzian Classification / kNN|Machine-learning scripts|Computed price features + historical labels|Uses a Lorentzian-style distance and approximate neighbour selection to classify future-direction labels from historical examples.|lorentzian|Training-label availability, neighbour chronology and in-sample selection must be checked in the actual code.

Adaptive ML Supertrend|Machine-learning scripts|ATR history + price|Clusters historical volatility into regimes and uses a selected cluster representative in a Supertrend calculation.|adaptivesupertrend|Volatility clustering is not proof of price prediction; fitting must use only past observations.

COT Index / net positioning|Positioning context|CFTC reports + publication timestamps|Transforms participant net positions, changes or historical min-max ranks into contextual series.|cot|Weekly observation date is not public release time; never backfill Tuesday knowledge into a live decision before publication.

Open Interest / price-OI regimes|Positioning context|Exchange derivative open interest|Measures outstanding contracts and combines OI changes with price changes to describe participation.|openinterest|Not a spot CFD field; contract rolls and aggregation affect the series.

Options IV / skew / term structure / gamma|Options context|Options chains + rates + model assumptions|Summarizes option-implied uncertainty and exposure across strikes and expiries.|gamma,impliedvolatility|Dealer gamma sign and ownership are often estimated rather than directly observed.

Intermarket ratios / rolling correlation / beta|Cross-market context|Time-aligned prices of multiple instruments|Compares markets using ratios, covariances, rolling regressions or residuals.|correl,beta,Correlation|Availability timestamps and different trading hours matter; relationships may change sign.

Seasonality / session statistics|Calendar context|Timestamped historical returns|Groups past observations by month, weekday or exchange-session clock to describe recurring distributions.|seasonality,seasonal|Avoid full-sample averages that leak the evaluation period into its own reference.

EIA inventories / crude time spreads|Oil-specific context|EIA releases + separately quoted futures maturities|Inventory changes describe physical balances; near/far futures spreads describe the term structure.|eia,calendarspread|Release timestamp, revisions and contract identity are required; a CFD candle alone cannot supply these data.

Gold real-yield / dollar / GVZ context|Gold-specific context|FRED real yields + dollar reference + options volatility|Adds separate macro/volatility series alongside gold prices for analysis.|gvz,realyield|These are contextual data inputs, not a guaranteed negative or positive relationship with gold.

Nasdaq breadth / VXN / relative strength|Equity-index context|Constituent prices + index/options data|Measures participation across constituent stocks, implied volatility or relative performance versus a reference index.|AdvanceDeclineRatio,AdvanceDeclineDifference|Use historical constituents and weights to avoid survivorship bias; QQQ is a reference feed in this project.

DAX session / breadth / volatility context|Equity-index context|Eurex/Xetra sessions + constituents + optional volatility data|Aligns futures, cash-index trading and constituent participation to a documented exchange session.|sessions|DAX cash, FDAX futures and a broker CFD are distinct series and can have different prices/hours.
